title: Deliver Copper Ore to Tuningville Factory
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Copper Ore** delivered to **Tuningville Factory** (industry id 10, near tile 30,45).

A likely supplier is **Bondinghead Copper Ore Mine** (industry id 1, near tile 29,17); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **330 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
